data.name: Clash of Peaks: Dynasty in Your Grasp
data.detailed_description:
This is a PC basketball game that emphasizes "easy to learn and highly free-form competition." Its core features are fast-paced battles and diverse gameplay, allowing players of all skill levels to experience the thrill of basketball.

It primarily features fast-paced 1v1 matches with freely controllable game length, suitable for fragmented entertainment.

It integrates real-time operation and tactical deployment. Players can control their players to perform basic actions such as breakthroughs, shots, and dunks, while controlling the game's pace through pre-match lineup combinations and in-game tactical switching.

It incorporates a counter-system, with different positions and players possessing unique skills, such as guards' lightning-fast breakthroughs, centers' dominance under the basket, and forwards' all-around offensive and defensive abilities, requiring flexible adjustments based on the opponent's lineup.

The fast-paced and immersive gameplay allows for quick starts without complex setups, perfect for short bursts of entertainment.

It balances competitive and entertaining attributes, offering both hardcore battles and fun modes to cater to different player preferences.

It lowers the learning curve for beginners while retaining room for advanced gameplay.

Featuring high-definition, minimalist court graphics, smooth animations, and realistic physics-based collision feedback, coupled with rousing background music, the game recreates the immersive experience of being on the court.

The simple yet exquisite game graphics faithfully reproduce the atmosphere of a basketball game, while dynamic sound effects and real-time match reports ensure that every successful shot and every crucial defensive play is filled with a sense of accomplishment.
